item.title: Modern E-Commerce Candle Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to take my candle business online with a fully functional, modern storefront that feels as bold and vibrant as my product line. The site should showcase every scent and size in an easy-to-browse catalogue, then guide shoppers smoothly through a secure checkout that accepts major cards, PayPal, and other standard gateways.
Design & branding • Visual style: clean, contemporary layouts, vivid color pops that echo my brightest candle labels, and plenty of white space so photography stands out. • Mobile-first responsiveness is a must; most of my customers browse on their phones.
Core features • Product pages with high-resolution galleries, clear pricing tiers, and real-time stock indicators. • A built-in wish list so visitors can save their favorite fragrances for later. • Newsletter sign-up tied to Mailchimp (or a comparable service) so I can send launch promos and seasonal updates. • Simple admin dashboard where I can add new collections, run discount codes, and pull sales reports without touching code.
Tech flexibility Whether you prefer Shopify, WooCommerce, or another reliable e-commerce stack, I’m open—as long as load times stay fast and future SEO work isn’t hampered. Payment integration with Stripe is my first choice, but I’ll consider alternatives if they keep fees low.
Deliverables 1. Fully deployed site on my custom domain, SSL secured. 2. Theme and graphics aligned with my bold, vibrant palette. 3. Configured wish list and newsletter modules, tested end-to-end. 4. Documentation (or a short Loom walkthrough) showing me how to add products, run promotions, and view orders. 5. Two weeks of post-launch support for minor tweaks or bug fixes.
If this sounds like a project you can light up, tell me which platform you’d use and show a couple of modern e-commerce sites you’ve built.

item.title: Wix Cleaning Website With Booking
item.description:
30-250 AUD | I’m rebuilding my cleaning company’s web presence on Wix and I need it finished as soon as possible. The site must look professional, feel trustworthy, read clearly, and—above all—convert visitors into enquiries. Lead generation is my only measure of success, so every page needs strong calls-to-action that funnel prospects toward either a quote request or a simple appointment through Wix Bookings.
Navigation is already mapped out: Home, About, Services ( subpages Residential Cleaning Sydney -Commercial Cleaning Sydney -Strata Cleaning Sydney -End of Lease Cleaning Sydney -Deep House Cleaning -Airbnb & Short Stay Cleaning Sydney -Carpet and Upholstery Cleaning -Pressure Washing Sydney ), Pricing & Quotes, Contact, and a standalone Book Online page. I’ll supply logo, palette, and any service copy you need; your job is to shape it into a clean, sales-focused layout, optimise it for mobile, and wire in the Wix booking widget for straightforward, single-visit appointments. A streamlined quote form should sit on the Pricing & Quotes page so visitors can move from curiosity to conversion in one click.
On-page SEO matters too. I expect keyword-targeted headings, meta titles & descriptions, compressed images with alt tags, and logical internal linking that helps Google and users alike. Each service page should be indexed properly for “Cleaning Sydney” search intent, and the site speed needs to stay snappy once everything is live.
Deliverables (acceptance criteria) • Fully built Wix site reflecting the stated page structure and child pages • Simple appointment booking flow via Wix Bookings, tested end-to-end • Custom quote request form that emails submissions to me instantly • On-page SEO applied across all pages (titles, metas, schema where relevant) • Responsive design proofed on desktop, tablet, and mobile • Handover with edit instructions so I can update text and pricing later
If you’ve launched conversion-driven Wix sites before and can hit a rapid turnaround, let’s talk and get this live.

item.title: Complete WordPress Revamp & Security
item.description:
250-750 AUD | My WordPress site has been online for many years without a proper refresh and the cracks are starting to show. I’m ready for a thorough overhaul that touches every layer—theme design, plugins, and content—while making the site genuinely hacker-proof.
Here’s what I have in mind:
• Full visual redesign that feels modern and responsive on all devices. • Plugin audit and replacement where necessary so everything runs efficiently on the latest WordPress and PHP versions. • Content restructure: migrate what still works, clean out what doesn’t, and set up easy-to-use blocks or page-builder sections for future updates. • Security hardening as the top priority: firewall rules, malware scanning, secure login, backups, and any best-practice measures you recommend. • Performance optimisation (caching, image compression, CDN setup if suitable) so the revamped site loads fast. • A smooth migration plan that keeps the current site online until the new version is ready, then flips over with minimal downtime.
After launch I’d like the option of an affordable monthly retainer for monitoring, updates, and quick fixes, but we can scope that separately once the rebuild is complete.
Please tell me: – Examples of WordPress sites you’ve rebuilt from the ground up. – The security stack or plugins you prefer (e.g., Wordfence, Sucuri, iThemes, or a custom approach). – Estimated timeline from kickoff to go-live.
I’ll provide current site access, hosting credentials, and brand assets as soon as we agree on the plan. Let’s bring this site up to date and lock it down together.

item.title: Refine and Organize Odoo 19 Municipal Website
item.description:
30-250 USD | ## Project Title
Refine and Professionally Organize an Existing Odoo 19 Municipal Website
## Project Description
Our company is seeking an experienced web designer/developer to refine and professionally organize our existing Odoo19 website.
This is not a ground-up website design project. The website theme, page structure, graphic materials, most text content, and supporting screenshots are already prepared. The main responsibility is to improve, organize, and polish the existing material so the website looks professional, clear, consistent, and easy to navigate.
Our company provides solutions for municipalities and counties, including:
- Municipal ERP and CMS solutions - Accessible government websites - Accessibility tools and APIs - Website accessibility audits - Future digital-service and accessibility features
## Scope of Work
The freelancer will: 1. Review the supplied Odoo 19 website materials and screenshots. 2. Refine existing pages rather than redesigning the project unnecessarily. 3. Improve spacing, typography, headings, layout, visual hierarchy, and readability. 4. Ensure each page contains an appropriate amount of concise and meaningful content. 5. Position supplied images and graphics in relevant locations with suitable sizes and proportions. 6. Organize the Solutions menu so users can easily find: - Websites for municipalities and counties - Accessibility tools - Accessibility APIs - Accessibility audits - ERP and CMS solutions - Other relevant services and future offerings. 7. Create dedicated pages for major solutions or clearly labeled in-page tabs/sections where appropriate. 8. Preserve the existing visual identity and use the supplied theme and graphic materials consistently. 9. Keep the structure flexible so additional features and services can be added later.
## Materials We Will Provide We will provide: - The existing website theme. - Existing pages and page structure. - Most of the written content. - Screenshots showing the intended direction and current material. - Odoo 19 website materials and files. - Graphic files and other relevant design assets. The freelancer is expected to refine and implement the supplied materials, not replace them with an unrelated design or structure. Where text is missing or too short to complete a necessary section, Lorem Ipsum may be used occasionally as temporary placeholder text. Any placeholder must have a clear title indicating the intended purpose of the section. Placeholder text should not be used as a substitute for available or reasonably editable content. ## Expected Deliverables: - A refined and professionally organized Odoo 19 website. - Clear and intuitive navigation. - An improved Solutions menu. - Dedicated or clearly accessible pages/sections for each major solution. - Better page spacing, typography, layout, and content presentation. - Correct placement and sizing of supplied graphics. - Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts. - Appropriate temporary placeholders where genuinely necessary. - Screenshots of progress daily or every other day showing meaningful updates on refined page layouts or navigation improvements (to ensure alignment). - Final work compatible with the supplied Odoo 19 materials.

item.title: eCentral Marketplace — Website Redesign & SEO Project
item.description:
750-1500 USD | # eCentral Marketplace — Website Redesign & SEO Project
**Website:** https://ecentralmarketplace.com/
We are looking for an experienced **WordPress designer/developer and SEO specialist** to redesign and optimize our entire website. The goal is to create a modern, professional, mobile-friendly website that is easy to navigate, SEO-optimized, and built to generate more leads.
## 1. Complete Website Redesign
* Redesign the entire website with a modern, professional look. * Improve navigation, layout, typography, images, and overall user experience. * Create a clean, mobile-friendly design for desktop, tablet, and mobile. * Improve homepage and all existing service pages. * Add stronger calls-to-action and quote/contact buttons. * Improve forms, testimonials, FAQs, footer, and menus. * Use professional, relevant images throughout the site. * Optimize the design for conversions and lead generation.
## 2. SEO Content & Keyword Optimization
* Perform keyword research for all major insurance services. * Identify primary, secondary, long-tail, and local keywords. * Rewrite and improve existing website content for SEO and conversions. * Make content professional, clear, original, and easy to read. * Optimize content around search intent without keyword stuffing. * Add relevant FAQs and calls-to-action where needed.
## 3. On-Page SEO
Optimize every important page for:
* SEO titles and meta descriptions * H1, H2, and H3 headings * Primary and secondary keywords * URLs/slugs * Image file names and alt text * Internal linking * Anchor text * Breadcrumbs where appropriate
Make sure each page has a clear SEO focus and unique metadata.
## 4. Technical & Back-End SEO
Perform a complete technical SEO audit and fix issues involving:
* XML sitemap * Robots.txt * Indexing and crawlability * Canonical URLs * Redirects and broken links * Duplicate content * Mobile usability * Website speed * Core Web Vitals * Image optimization * Plugins and unnecessary scripts * Schema/structured data * WordPress SEO settings
Review Google Search Console if access is provided and correct applicable issues.
## 5. Create 4 New State-Specific Pages
Create four unique, SEO-optimized pages for:
* Florida * Georgia * North Carolina * Texas
Each page should include:
* Unique state-specific content * SEO title and meta description * H1/H2/H3 structure * Relevant insurance services * State-specific keywords * FAQs * Internal links * Images with optimized alt text * Strong calls-to-action * Quote/contact opportunities
Do not simply duplicate one page and change the state name. Each page should provide unique and useful content.
## Final Deliverables
The completed website must be:
* Professionally redesigned * SEO optimized * Mobile responsive * Fast and functional * Properly structured for search engines * Optimized for lead generation * Fully tested on desktop and mobile * Free of broken links and major technical issues
**Please provide examples of websites you have designed and SEO-optimized, preferably for insurance, healthcare, financial, or other service businesses.**

item.title: Women's Hormone Health Clinic Website Design
item.description:
250-750 USD | I am launching a new cash-pay telehealth clinic focused on perimenopause, menopause, and women’s hormone health.
The clinic will provide virtual consultations, lab ordering, prescription management, and ongoing care through a membership model.
The initial market is Florida, with plans to expand to additional states in the future.
What I need
I’m looking for an experienced website designer/developer to create a polished, modern website for the clinic.
I already have the business name, logo direction, brand colors, and overall aesthetic, so I’m primarily looking for someone to bring the brand to life online rather than develop the branding from scratch.
Desired aesthetic
I want the website to feel:
* Modern and elevated * Feminine but not overly “girly” * Warm and approachable * Medically credible and professional * Clean and easy to navigate * Designed specifically for women in perimenopause/menopause * Excellent on mobile
Think modern women’s healthcare, rather than a traditional doctor’s office or generic wellness website.
Website needs
Likely pages will include:
* Home * About * Menopause / HRT * Services * Membership & Pricing * How It Works * FAQ * Contact * Book a Consultation
The site should support/integrate online booking, contact forms, and links to the appropriate patient/EMR system.
I’d also like the website to be easy for the business owner to update after launch.
Experience I’m looking for
Healthcare experience is important. Ideally, you have worked with:
* Telehealth * Women’s health * Menopause/perimenopause * HRT/hormone health * Medical practices * Cash-pay or membership-based healthcare
Platform
I am currently planning to use Squarespace, but I’m open to another platform if you have a strong reason to recommend it.
Budget
$500–$1,000, depending on experience, portfolio, and scope.
When applying
Please send:
1. 2–3 examples of healthcare, telehealth, women’s health, menopause, or hormone-related websites you’ve built. 2. Your estimated price and timeline. 3. What is included in your price. 4. Which platform you recommend and why. 5. Any experience integrating booking, EMR/patient portals, or healthcare forms. 6. Confirmation that you personally build/design the site rather than outsourcing the work.
I’m looking for someone who can create something that feels credible, modern, feminine, and trustworthy, while making it very easy for a potential patient to understand the services and book a consultation.
